title: The vocabulary gate refuses the bible while p007 is open
text: Animatic 04 ran the blocking step of animation_animatic with the animation-vocabulary gate in the chain, and the engine's shell check FAILED (exit 1): `FAIL proposals: owner-ask p007 has no intent, options, default`. The vocabulary check requires every owner-ask to carry an intent word, its options as vocabulary words and a default (the form D96 fixed); p007, filed with the light layer, has the question in prose and none of the three. The light row is open on p005-p007 and this run did not touch them, so the chain is held at its second step (attempt 1 of 2 used) and the later steps, among them the evidence step where the animation-bible gate runs, have not run in the chain. What unblocks it: p007 gets its intent, options and default (the planner's or the owner's wording), then the same answer is sent again to the held chain.
before: owner-ask p007: question in prose only; vocabulary gate exit 1 in the chain (receipt evidence/drive-uzeuoq, mailbox/animatic-04/04-step.md)
after: owner-ask p007 carries intent, options and default; the vocabulary gate passes in the chain
